does: Toasts raw rice in a dry pan until deep gold and grinds it coarse, for a nutty, crunchy seasoning.
how: Put raw rice in a dry pan over medium heat.
Shake and stir it often as it turns from white to golden to deep gold.
Tip it out to cool, then grind it coarse in a mortar or a spice grinder.

mistakes.mistake: Toasting over high heat, so the outside burns and the inside stays raw.
mistakes.fix: Keep the heat medium and keep the grains moving.

mistakes.mistake: Grinding it to a fine flour.
mistakes.fix: Stop while it is still a little gritty.
